title: Extension of a CNF assignment
statement: Let $n$ and $a$ be nonnegative integers. Given assignments of signs in $\{-1,1\}$ to the first $n$ coordinates and to the $a$ auxiliary coordinates, their extension to $n+a$ coordinates agrees with the first assignment on the first block and with the auxiliary assignment on the second block.
hypotheses_covered: Assignment of signs to the original coordinates
Assignment of signs to the auxiliary coordinates
